testing_mode: GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
DD2 (partial — sprint cluster): bash blocks + EMIT-PRECONDITIONS landmarks at sprint fallthrough sites

## What
Read the frozen inventory (T2) to identify sprint cluster fallthrough sites. Add EMIT-PRECONDITIONS HTML comment landmarks + bash blocks at each site in the sprint skill files. Remove sprint cluster RED markers from .test-index.

## Target Files
- plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md
- plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/auto-resume.md
- plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/test-failure-dispatch-protocol.md

## Instrumentation Pattern (per T2 frozen format)
At each fallthrough site identified in the inventory:
1. Insert: <!-- EMIT-PRECONDITIONS: gate_name=<name> degradation_type=<type> -->
2. Insert bash block calling preconditions-record.sh with --degradation --degradation-type flags and 2>/dev/null || true

## .test-index Changes
REMOVE these RED markers:
plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md:tests/scripts/test-preconditions-fallthrough-landmarks.sh [test_sprint_cluster_landmarks]
plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/auto-resume.md:tests/scripts/test-preconditions-fallthrough-landmarks.sh [test_sprint_cluster_landmarks]
plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/test-failure-dispatch-protocol.md:tests/scripts/test-preconditions-fallthrough-landmarks.sh [test_sprint_cluster_landmarks]

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] EMIT-PRECONDITIONS landmark present in sprint/SKILL.md
  Verify: grep -q 'EMIT-PRECONDITIONS' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md
- [ ] EMIT-PRECONDITIONS landmark present in auto-resume.md
  Verify: grep -q 'EMIT-PRECONDITIONS' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/auto-resume.md
- [ ] EMIT-PRECONDITIONS landmark present in test-failure-dispatch-protocol.md
  Verify: grep -q 'EMIT-PRECONDITIONS' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/test-failure-dispatch-protocol.md
- [ ] Bash blocks use fail-open pattern (2>/dev/null || true)
  Verify: grep -A5 'EMIT-PRECONDITIONS' plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md | grep -q '|| true'
- [ ] Sprint RED markers removed from .test-index
  Verify: ! grep '\[test_sprint_cluster_landmarks\]' .test-index
- [ ] test_sprint_cluster_landmarks passes
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-preconditions-fallthrough-landmarks.sh test_sprint_cluster_landmarks
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures: escalate to user
